units.source_text: 金花把椅子稍稍往后挪动了下，嘴里还含着瓜子，露出了为难的表情。

en.t: Jinhua moved the chair slightly backward, still holding melon seeds in her mouth, and showed an embarrassed, troubled expression.

units.source_text: 心里暗想，看来客人误会了她是因为两美元太少，所以不愿意跟他过夜。

en.t: She thought to herself that the customer must have misunderstood, assuming she refused to spend the night with him because two dollars was too little.

units.source_text: 但是两个人语言不通，想要让她明白自己的苦衷，真的很难。

en.t: But the two of them did not share a language, so making her understand his predicament was truly difficult.

units.source_text: 到了如今这个样子，金花开是后悔自己的草率主动，

en.t: Now that things had come to this, Jinhua began to regret how rashly she had taken the initiative,

units.source_text: 她亮晶晶的眼睛转了记下看，只能无可奈何的摇了摇头。

en.t: Her bright eyes darted around a few times, and all she could do was shake her head helplessly.
